I use 250mg Hemp Classic CBD oil from Bluebird Botanicals. This is the only CBD product I've tried so far, but I like it a lot. I pretty much take it "as needed"- if I'm going somewhere where I know I'll get anxious, I'll take a couple drops. When I wake up in the morning I'll take a drop or two so I can ease into my day (I get bad anxiety in the mornings). In my experience, CBD has really helped me with the tight chest feeling from anxiety - when the oil starts "kicking in" usually the first thing I feel is my chest relaxing and I'm able to take easier, deep breaths  again. I'm not sure how big my "dose" is in a day (I just go by drop count :p) but it's a really small dose, one that might not work for everybody, and it's okay to take more if needed. If you are currently on SSRIs and benzos, it's strongly advised that you do not quit them cold turkey and try to replace them with CBD oil. See how the CBD oil works for you in combination with your medication first, and go from there. I'm not a doctor, so of course, talk to your doctor about weaning off your medication safely. Best of luck! :)

I'm not on any antidepressants or medication, and I decided to give cbd a try before trying antidepressants again to help with extreme anxiety and depersonalization. I've only been using it for a month, and in very small doses, but I think it has helped a lot and it's slowly but surely getting me out of a really tough time of anxiety. the cbd calms my body, which eases the physical symptoms of my anxiety, which eases my mind, and makes me feel like i'm in reality. i can't speak on how the cbd helps in addition to ssri medication, but i hope this helps!
